connector.name: valv
connector.registryDescription: Let coding agents query any SQL database safely. Read-only by default and scoped by your policies.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace sh.valv, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Database connection string. PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, CockroachDB, or a ClickHouse HTTP URL.

env.name: VALV_PROVIDER
env.description: Datasource provider: postgresql, mysql, sqlite, or clickhouse. Inferred from DATABASE_URL when omitted.

env.name: VALV_DATABASE
env.description: Database name. Required for ClickHouse, whose URL does not carry one.

env.name: VALV_TABLES
env.description: Comma-separated allow-list of tables. When set, only these are exposed to the agent.

env.name: VALV_EXCLUDE
env.description: Comma-separated deny-list of tables, applied after the allow-list.

env.name: VALV_POLICY_FILE
env.description: Path to a policy module that takes full control of access. Without it, the server is read-only across all tables.

env.name: VALV_CONTEXT
env.description: JSON context object the policy reads, e.g. {"tenant":{"id":"acme"}}.

env.name: VALV_HTTP_PORT
env.description: Serve over Streamable HTTP on this port instead of stdio.

recipes.cli: claude mcp add mcp --env DATABASE_URL=<your-database-url> --env VALV_PROVIDER=<valv-provider> --env VALV_DATABASE=<valv-database> --env VALV_TABLES=<valv-tables> --env VALV_EXCLUDE=<valv-exclude> --env VALV_POLICY_FILE=/absolute/path/to/target --env VALV_CONTEXT=<valv-context> --env VALV_HTTP_PORT=<valv-http-port> -- npx -y @valv/mcp@0.6.2

recipes.code:
[mcp_servers.mcp]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@valv/mcp@0.6.2"]

[mcp_servers.mcp.env]
DATABASE_URL = "<your-database-url>"
VALV_PROVIDER = "<valv-provider>"
VALV_DATABASE = "<valv-database>"
VALV_TABLES = "<valv-tables>"
VALV_EXCLUDE = "<valv-exclude>"
VALV_POLICY_FILE = "/absolute/path/to/target"
VALV_CONTEXT = "<valv-context>"
VALV_HTTP_PORT = "<valv-http-port>"
